tools.name: ask_miroshark
tools.description: Ask a natural-language question about MiroShark and get ranked, cited resources from its pages (what it is, how to run it, pricing, docs, ecosystem). Same ranking as the public /ask endpoint.

tools.name: get_ecosystem
tools.description: The projects and partners building with MiroShark, parsed from the canonical ECOSYSTEM.md.

tools.name: get_health
tools.description: MiroShark site readiness: whether the process booted and which feature areas are configured (booleans only, never secret values).

tools.name: miroshark_overview
tools.description: What MiroShark is and when to use it. Returns a short description of the swarm-simulation engine and the kinds of questions it answers.

tools.name: miroshark_resources
tools.description: Key MiroShark developer resources: machine contract (OpenAPI), integration docs, authentication, MCP server, site map, and socials.

tools.name: miroshark_run
tools.description: How to run a MiroShark simulation, including the price and the x402 payment flow.

tools.name: open_run_panel
tools.description: Open MiroShark's run panel with a scenario pre-loaded, and take the user there. Use this to act on a user's request to run/simulate something: pass a seed (prompt, url, OR article; prompt wins if several are given) and, optionally, a prediction-market question. This is a handoff, not a purchase - it stops at the panel so the user reviews the scenario and authorizes the paid $1 x402 run themselves. Call suggest_scenarios first if the user's idea is still vague. Returns where it opened and the seed kind loaded.

url.description: An article URL to seed the simulation from.

article.description: Raw article text to seed the simulation from.

market_question.description: Optional prediction-market question to pin to the run.

tools.name: suggest_scenarios
tools.description: Turn a vague topic into up to 5 concrete, launchable MiroShark scenarios (title, pitch, ready-to-run prompt, angle). A free pre-flight before paying for a run - use it to help a user go from a fuzzy idea to a seed prompt worth simulating. Pair with open_run_panel (in-page) to load a chosen idea into the run panel.

topic.description: The rough topic or question to expand into scenario ideas.
